Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).name: Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival)
Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Tsuyu Asui, hero name Froppy, the Rainy Season Hero: a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast she rode inside Mezo Shoji's arms with Minoru Mineta in the cavalry battle, snatching at headbands with her tongue; the team missed the final rounds. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop, huge round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit" now and then (most lines go without it); asks everyone to call her Tsu.
Combat Role: Mobile rescuer and restrainer who leaps, clings, swims and snatches with her tongue; light on power, slowed by cold.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter, names the safe route and pulls the most exposed person clear.
Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival rewarded flash; her Quirk shines in rescue, as it did at the USJ with no cameras watching. Motivation: Become a hero who saves people at sea, and be ready the next time villains come. Concealment: How frightened she was at the USJ; she mentions it once, flatly, and moves on. Connections: Izuku Midoriya and Minoru Mineta, her partners in the flood zone at the USJ, where Izuku's plan, Mineta's sticky balls and her leap got all three out of the water. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack she knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, whose hand closed on her face until Shota Aizawa's Erasure stopped his Quirk; the warp villain Kurogiri; a Nomu built to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Sizes up a rival in one flat sentence; shrugs off a loss with a "ribbit" and cheers the classmates still in it. Thread: Whether she can turn the fear the USJ left into readiness for the next real fight.
QUIRK: Frog: leaps, swimming, wall-clinging and a tongue of about twenty meters that grabs, carries or binds; cold makes her sluggish.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Froppy, a name she has wanted since she was small; Midnight praised it as friendly.
personality: Frank: Tells teammates what will and will not work, without softening it.
Unflappable: Keeps a straight face in front of crowds, cameras and villains alike.
Watchful: Keeps a closer eye on classmates hurt at the USJ than she lets on.
Speaking style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit"; never sugarcoats.
abilities: Frog mobility: Fast leaps and a sure grip on walls and ceilings; she needs footing to launch, and cold weakens her.
Tongue grab: Snatches a headband, a tool or a teammate at range; heavy loads and poor footing limit the pull.
Tongue bind: Wraps an opponent to hold or unbalance them, never to strangle; a strong opponent can break free.
Water rescue: Carried two classmates out of deep water in one leap at the USJ; cold water saps her.
Level head: Names the next safe move while others panic; she cannot make them listen.
Fighting style: Plays for position, snatching what matters with her tongue from a safe angle; teammates do the heavy hitting.
Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young woman with very long dark-green hair tied into a loose loop at the ends, very large round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth set in a calm, closed line, fair skin and a short, lean build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Calm, deadpan expression with steady, watchful eyes.
